name: RIVEN
old_description: RIVEN is a multidisciplinary studio that designs heirloom quality furniture and objects.  Each piece is carefully handcrafted in our Vermont workshop using time honored techniques and Eco-friendly finishes.  Our mission is to elevate the everyday through elegant, understated design.
about:
RIVEN is a multidisciplinary design studio and workshop based in Burlington, Vermont. The company creates heirloom-quality furniture and objects, each piece handcrafted on-site using time-honored techniques and eco-friendly finishes. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The studio's capabilities span bespoke furniture design and manufacturing, interior design, product development, prototyping, and eco-finishing services. Production occurs in a Vermont workshop where traditional woodworking methods are applied to create custom pieces for clients.

RIVEN works with both private individuals and business clients, delivering tailored design and manufacturing solutions for residential and commercial projects. The studio's service offerings are structured to support clients from concept through finished product.

The company's stated mission is to elevate the everyday through elegant, understated design, emphasizing heirloom quality and sustainable finishing practices as core differentiators.
